content.title: About Valero | Our Products Fuel Modern Life
content.text: Skip to main content About Valero Our Products Fuel Modern Life And Make a Better Future Possible How We Fuel the World We are the best-in-class producer of liquid transportation fuels and products that are essential to modern life. Not just today, but for generations to come. We are the world's premier independent petroleum refiner and a leading producer of low-carbon transportation fuels. We’re proud of fueling lives with a commitment to safe, reliable and environmentally responsible operations. This will always be our top priority. Off Valero | Who We Are Fortune 500 company (NYSE: VLO) Headquartered in San Antonio, Texas ~10,000 employees World’s premier independent refiner 15 refineries in the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom with 3.2 million barrels per day (bpd) of high-complexity throughput capacity 12 ethanol plants in the U.S. with 1.7 billion gallons per year of production capacity Off A joint venture member in Diamond Green Diesel Holdings LLC (DGD) with two plants in the Gulf Coast region of the U.S. and annual production capacity of up to 1.2 billion gallons of renewable diesel and up to 235 million gallons of Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) Leading producer of low-carbon transportation fuels World's 2nd largest corn ethanol producer World's 2nd largest renewable diesel producer Large-scale producer of SAF Off Achieved our best year ever in 2024 for safety performance for employees, and for employees and contractors on a combined basis Achieved our best year ever in 2024 for Tier 1 API Process Safety performance in our refining segment Off Who We Are Guiding Principles We are guided by five principles in Safety, Environment, Community, Employees and Governance. Our Guiding Principles Our Awards Off Leadership Our executive team and board of directors are committed to a comprehensive liquid fuels strategy underpinned by excellence in operations, disciplined capital allocation and commitment to shareholder returns. Executive Team Board of Directors Off Our Story Advancing the Future of Energy Valero is leading through innovation, ingenuity and unmatched execution to responsibly meet the world's growing demand for reliable and affordable energy. Our History See the Latest Company News Off Our Locations Valero owns 15 petroleum refineries in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. and 12 ethanol plants in the U.S. Midwest. Valero is also a joint venture member in DGD, which produces low-carbon fuels at two plants adjacent to Valero's refineries at St. Charles, Louisiana, and Port Arthur, Texas.
